subject: One local SEO agency for MapRank — free example
text:
Hi MapRank team,

I saw MapRank's launch for local SEO agencies and prepared one agency you could approach with a specific reporting comparison:

Pro Local Builder — https://www.prolocalbuilder.com/seo
Published business contact: hello@prolocalbuilder.com
Its SEO plans already include Google Maps work, keyword tracking and monthly reports. Its founders serve Wisconsin, the Bay Area and Las Vegas.

A useful opening is one approved client keyword across its actual service area, comparing the geographic detail and client-readable report with the agency's existing monthly workflow. The attached free profile includes the original source, a suggested introduction and what to confirm about its current tool. The CSV is editable.

Five additional US and Canadian agency profiles are already prepared for US$20 total. Each has a published business contact, an existing local SEO/reporting service and an individual comparison idea. One correction or replacement within seven days is included for an existing customer, duplicate, dead published contact or clear mismatch.

Would that five-profile pack be useful for your next outreach batch?

Bryce
Token Junkie Labs
